source_scope: Existing additive-containing nonfoamed REF 2mm vulcanizate, shared by independent density/tensile-strength/stress-at-specified-elongation references. Each property keeps its own methods/statistics and unknowns. M100/M200 now map to source-labelled stresses at100%/200% elongation, never Young modulus. No universal isotropy, pure-NBR, foam or elemental-sulfur conversion claim; Figure1 third-party content excluded. Source-labelled tensile break elongation separately recorded on original percentage scale; statistics property-specific, strain estimator/gauge/fracture selection unknown.
